What makes a good seed ／ 好苗头的标准：
- Single source: only one place is talking about it so far, no follow-up coverage yet ／ 单源：目前只有一处在说，还没有多家跟进
- Fresh: it just appeared — not yesterday's already-trending news ／ 新：刚出现不久，不是已经上热搜的旧闻
- First-hand link: the original page (repo / original post / official site / paper), not a second-hand roundup ／ 有一手链接：原始页面（仓库 / 原帖 / 官网 / 论文），不要二手搬运合集
- A one-line reason: why you think it will grow ／ 一句话理由：为什么你觉得它会长大

Seeds land in the intake list first. At the next scan they are deduplicated and checked for resonance; only qualifying ones reach the seed board — submission is not a promise of inclusion.
投来的苗头先进收件清单，下一期扫描时去重、查共振，够格才进苗头榜，不承诺收录。

Note: this template is the canonical copy in the engine repo. An instance's submissions are collected in its own data repo (Dai's instance: daiyanze/breaker-delta-data — its submit page opens the issue form there).
注：本模板是引擎仓里的正本。各实例的投苗收在自己的数据仓里（Dai 的实例为 daiyanze/breaker-delta-data，投苗页会在那里打开 Issue 表单）。
